run_diffusion_training: run the diffusion model training script with hydra config on local GPUs via mpiexec
run_training_on_slurm: run the diffusion model training script using submitit mode on a Slurm cluster
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume diffusion model training from a saved checkpoint path in the trainer config
setup_model_and_dataloader: call setup from script_util with train=True to get model, diffusion, and dataloader
instantiate_trainer: instantiate a trainer via hydra.utils using the config, model, diffusion, and dataloader
